build_sentence_embeddings: build sentence embeddings from a list of texts using a SentenceTransformer model with multi-process encoding
build_lookahead_embeddings: build lookahead embeddings by producing masked language model variations and averaging their sentence embeddings
test_similarity_class: test the Similarity class by comparing embedding norms between identical and different text items
review_similarity_sentence_embedding: review the Similarity.sentence_embedding method that encodes texts using a multi-process pool with configurable batch size
review_similarity_lookahead_embedding: review the Similarity.lookahead_embedding method that generates variations via MLM masking and computes mean embeddings
